# experience
- AI Developer & IT Infrastructure — Poddie (Poddie Ops / POPS): built
  the company's IT infrastructure and a custom serverless ERP system
  (Cloudflare Workers, D1, Durable Objects, R2) running an entire
  manufacturing pipeline end to end, with real-time collaboration and
  two external ERP/CRM integrations (Katana MRP, Salesforce).
- Founder & Software Engineer — XIT (2020–2023): founded and sold a
  subscription-based web services company for SMBs, owning the full
  lifecycle from client acquisition to engineering and maintenance.
- AI Developer (Applied Automation & AI) — Clean Controlling: automated
  document monitoring system detecting regulatory changes, summarizing
  via AI (Gemini), and distributing updates to stakeholders.
- Security & Penetration Testing — Poddie (authorized engagement):
  conducted a penetration test and translated findings into risk
  assessments for non-technical stakeholders.
- Developer Tooling & ML Projects — independent: a VS Code commit
  message extension, ML systems for sports analytics, and small
  UX-focused experiments.

# featured projects
- Architectural Smells Detection: VS Code–native tool detecting cyclic
  dependencies, god classes, and feature envy via deterministic rules
  plus optional AI-assisted summarization.
- CleanControlling – AI-Based PDF Comparison Pipeline: compares local
  vs. vendor safety data sheets, runs AI (Gemini) analysis on changes,
  automates replacement and email notification.
- Poddie – Penetration Testing & Security Awareness: authorized pentest,
  multiple critical/medium findings, translated into stakeholder-facing
  risk guidance.
- Poddie Ops (POPS) – Operations Platform: serverless ERP on Cloudflare
  edge (Workers, D1, Durable Objects, R2), ~55-table schema, 70+
  migrations, bi-directional Katana MRP sync, Salesforce integration,
  gamified factory floor.
- XIT – Websites for Small & Medium Businesses: full-lifecycle web
  studio, founded 2020, sold 2023.
- Sports Match Outcome Prediction: ML models with feature engineering,
  evaluation, and interpretability focus.
- Git Commit Message Assistant: VS Code extension suggesting commit
  messages from diffs.
- Which Has More: minimal comparison-logic game focused on UX clarity.
